'''Imperial University''' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was funded by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during its reign. An [[Imperial University of Marngar III|Imperial university]] was also located on the celestial body [[Marngar III]].
